ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected surah.
   B. Say Selected surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Use Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
